title: Invert Spectator Scroll Speed
description: Minecraft 1.20.1 Fabric client-side mod for spectator game mode to invert speed controlling scrolling on touch pads
body:
Minecraft 1.20.1 Fabric client-side mod for spectator game mode to invert speed controlling scrolling on touch pads. To enable: go to Settings ➜ Mouse Settings ➜ Spectator: invert scrolling for speed controls.

![Screenshot of mouse settings](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b5536d16f2d787f80a94e658348e7ee6e186acce.webp)
